<p><strong>华为云Versatile智能体平台 体验入口：</strong><a href="https://auth.huaweicloud.com/authui/login.html?service=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.huaweicloud.com%2Fspace%2Flogin-forword.html%3FforwardUrl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fdeveloper.huaweicloud.com%252Fspace%252Fdevportal%252Fplatform%252Fwiseagent%252FdeveloperSpace%26module%3Dhuaweideveloper&amp;locale=zh-cn#/login" data-cke-saved-href="https://auth.huaweicloud.com/authui/login.html?service=https%3A%2F%2Fdeveloper.huaweicloud.com%2Fspace%2Flogin-forword.html%3FforwardUrl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fdeveloper.huaweicloud.com%252Fspace%252Fdevportal%252Fplatform%252Fwiseagent%252FdeveloperSpace%26module%3Dhuaweideveloper&amp;locale=zh-cn#/login" rel="noopener nofollow">华为开发者空间--开发平台--Versatile Agent</a>（请在PC端打开）</p>
<h2>版本概览</h2>
<p>华为云Versatile智能体平台定位为一站式企业级智能体构建平台，倡导人人都能构建自己的企业级智能体。</p>
<p>本次十一月版本升级，新增多项重点特性，包括Agent web分享能力、NL2Agent技术的落地——AI创建智能体、提示词工程体验重构、Agent观测等，以及知识库、平台资源订购等能力增强，更好地满足海量客户在企业级Agent平台上的使用需求，并致力于深化产品能力，持续与开发者合力构建易用、好用、开放的AI Agent平台。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-6b34f3a5c46a9b1881033d89718f3efc~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-b22a4a5463b1b6821d4baf2f0b587ff4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-6b34f3a5c46a9b1881033d89718f3efc~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-b22a4a5463b1b6821d4baf2f0b587ff4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>新增重点特性介绍</h2>
<h2>01 Agent web分享能力</h2>
<p><strong>应用管理</strong></p>
<p>支持单智能体应用、工作流应用发布为网页，可分享使用；并增加资源配置</p>
<p>业务价值：通过一键发布，支持在web端快捷访问智能体应用；可通过链接形式将Agent分享给他人体验，极大提升AI Agent的对外分享能力与成果使用率。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-939a2f231ac6233c0b2bc5556543794d~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-801e6dd966304ecf1462d3965f301138&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-939a2f231ac6233c0b2bc5556543794d~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-801e6dd966304ecf1462d3965f301138&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-b590e4cc9de0bb60783f6208a306bdc4~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-bcc4983c1f6944ffcd98725b515b2ee1&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-b590e4cc9de0bb60783f6208a306bdc4~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-bcc4983c1f6944ffcd98725b515b2ee1&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>02 一句话智能生成智能体</h2>
<p><strong>应用管理</strong></p>
<p>支持通过自然语言、对话交互式创建智能体，轻松实现AI创建应用</p>
<p>业务价值：用户通过自然语言描述需求，实现无码化、智能化创建单智能体应用、工作流应用，大幅降低构建AI应用的门槛。面向企业内用户，可显著减轻海量智能体创建的工作量。</p>
<p>入口一：首页概览对话区</p>

<h2>03 重构提示词功能</h2>
<p><strong>应用管理</strong></p>
<p>重构"创建提示词"功能，界面更新；重构"优化提示词"功能，可在提示词中引入变量，实现不同场景下的快速复用；新增变量数据测评集，实现模型辅助构建。</p>
<p>业务价值：简化提示词工程的开发流程，引入变量概念，借助大模型的学习能力，实现提示词的智能化构建。通过添加数据评测集和补充提示词背景知识等，可以帮助模型更好地理解提示词，多场景评测数据使提示词指令更加具体，输出更加符合预期。</p>

class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>04运营运维-观测</h2>
<p><strong>观测</strong></p>
<p>新增会话管理功能，支持查看Agent和工作流的会话历史。</p>
<p>业务价值：记录了智能体和工作流对话中的数据，可以更高效地管理和提升对话系统的性能。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-a32dadde23e85107764927c3953e0add~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-b9e5826482237e90c5e0ee0f4cf2a6e4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-a32dadde23e85107764927c3953e0add~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-b9e5826482237e90c5e0ee0f4cf2a6e4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-a32dadde23e85107764927c3953e0add~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-b9e5826482237e90c5e0ee0f4cf2a6e4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-a32dadde23e85107764927c3953e0add~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-b9e5826482237e90c5e0ee0f4cf2a6e4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>增加租户指标统计。租户指标统计页面，提供当前租户下智能体应用和工作流方面的关键使用数据，包括TOP10单智能体/工作流的Tokens消耗、TOP10单智能体/工作流的总调用量等。</p>
<p>业务价值：通过这些统计数据，您可以了解智能体和工作流的总数、新增数量、活跃情况以及资源消耗情况，帮助您优化资源分配，提高使用效率，并及时发现和解决问题。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-b6facf3c681a27baaeac1c1af1bac87e~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-0a04c6536cc5b3dc48180692e8c824a7&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-b6facf3c681a27baaeac1c1af1bac87e~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-0a04c6536cc5b3dc48180692e8c824a7&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-d9c3b158ac915f7ccc460ba533011491~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-373ab5837605270db5cc77aa6d0700a2&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-d9c3b158ac915f7ccc460ba533011491~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-373ab5837605270db5cc77aa6d0700a2&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>05 Agent应用支持发布到云商店</h2>
<p><strong>应用管理</strong></p>
<p>将单智能体、工作流应用发布到云商店后，生成OpenAPI URL，用户可以在华为云云商店通过调用</p>
<p>OpenAPI URL，即可将应用发布到云商店。</p>
<p>业务价值：用户可以通过云商店发布上架次接口，支持将Agent在云商店上架交易。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-3032476a6a2711d32e4c6c3f433e90a3~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-97634ee856bd7272e40943591efe79b6&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-3032476a6a2711d32e4c6c3f433e90a3~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-97634ee856bd7272e40943591efe79b6&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>06 单智能体应用能力拓展</h2>
<p><strong>应用管理</strong></p>
<p>单智能体在模型优先场景下，增加变量记忆功能，支持对用户变量进行设置。</p>
<p>业务价值：用户变量可存储使用项目过程中需要持久化存储和读取的数据，如用户的语言偏好、个性化设置等，能让智能体提供更个性化回复，更好响应用户的消息，提升输出内容的上下文关联度和准确性。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-1dc01e8f3627f7985a678d3bd734eb07~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-5805b65a9847cb1f2f7aa6db5be84de1&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-1dc01e8f3627f7985a678d3bd734eb07~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-5805b65a9847cb1f2f7aa6db5be84de1&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>调度模式支持工具优先功能。在处理用户的输入时，结合prompt，系统会优先判断用户添加的工具是否合适的，通过分析工具名称/描述/参数选择合适的工具来处理。</p>
<p>业务价值：基于用户指令意图，准确映射到匹配的插件，提升问题处理的精确度。适用于特定任务处理、高效任务执行、工具依赖性高的场景。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-4c552bc6cd8c35d6cd401e2314d51d51~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-f913f4bc4a1be0d70308410ce8b5eb43&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-4c552bc6cd8c35d6cd401e2314d51d51~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-f913f4bc4a1be0d70308410ce8b5eb43&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>单智能体应用在添加插件、工作流、MCP等时支持无断点，可在构建过程中进行开通、创建等操作。</p>
<p>业务价值：提升Agent创建全流程的流畅度，优化用户体验。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-004598c374d72718155816b16f67929d~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-5fae8cf52b29fe02ef3eccaac72681d4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-004598c374d72718155816b16f67929d~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-5fae8cf52b29fe02ef3eccaac72681d4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>07 多智能体应用优化</h2>
<p><strong>应用管理</strong></p>
<p>多智能体应用创建过程中，与其关联的工作流、智能体可以修改意图识别。</p>
<p>业务价值：增加修改子工作流意图识别的入口，提升多智能体应用的决策执行灵敏度。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-18ed2550ed296cdd45782762a7968e94~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-592551748f8976316171328ef69bf8e5&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-18ed2550ed296cdd45782762a7968e94~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-592551748f8976316171328ef69bf8e5&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>08 数据能力</h2>
<p><strong>知识库</strong></p>
<p>知识文档支持上传Markdown和HTML格式的文档。</p>
<p>业务价值：支持上传更多样的文档格式，提升文件解析能力，满足用户使用需求。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-b9e15b361ed650d350cc750e34786cc8~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-0df945b76f1aaa4749a7df1e730bd90c&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-b9e15b361ed650d350cc750e34786cc8~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-0df945b76f1aaa4749a7df1e730bd90c&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>新增知识库从obs桶（Object Storage Service,OBS）中拉取知识文件。</p>
<p>业务价值：通过对象存储服务（Object Storage Service,OBS）配置接入知识文档，实现快速调用，效率提升。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-e0aa04309ef3f2b2f5fb9c962e83d97c~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-04d651b0540fb5fb11cb54d858528502&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-e0aa04309ef3f2b2f5fb9c962e83d97c~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-04d651b0540fb5fb11cb54d858528502&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-17750169f99756e8fff592d0eede62b1~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-3723697e547b7b2387df27b2b2bc5c40&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-17750169f99756e8fff592d0eede62b1~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-3723697e547b7b2387df27b2b2bc5c40&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>提供多知识库并行检索能力。知识库检索接口支持语义、关键词、混合及FAQ四种检索模式，并允许自定义相似度阈值与返回结果数量。</p>
<p>业务价值1：丰富检索策略，实现更精准的知识调用。通过控制阈值，调节知识库与大模型之间的协作效能，实现精准高效的信息匹配。</p>
<p>业务价值2：知识库节点增加“启用FAQ”按钮，默认状态下关闭，支持跳过FAQ查询环节，直接查询文档切片，满足个性化内容检索需求。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-6bc3ebcf5e9f192d80a764ffe2bfa719~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-d973ac454f804f86f2be32fffdfaf827&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-6bc3ebcf5e9f192d80a764ffe2bfa719~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-d973ac454f804f86f2be32fffdfaf827&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-e859afa72d28a5bb893e923bf99fb5df~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-6b71c8697cf94cd3dd0de83759949720&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-e859afa72d28a5bb893e923bf99fb5df~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-6b71c8697cf94cd3dd0de83759949720&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>09 插件能力</h2>
<p><strong>组件库-我的插件</strong></p>
<p>支持创建函数类型插件。在函数编辑页面，可以创建并上传自定义依赖包，依赖包可包含自定义代码。</p>
<p>业务价值：丰富插件创建方式，可实现代码复用，简化流程，以提高工具的灵活性和功能性。</p>
<p><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-39cf198a3701207b854d53c51ac60a86~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-868d1d075ff61086089fb543d8e96278&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-39cf198a3701207b854d53c51ac60a86~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-868d1d075ff61086089fb543d8e96278&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"><img data-cke-saved-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-f49412778ee8978dcc971f738e802a45~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-21914c6ce5d54299214a03d1d6e8fdb4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-f49412778ee8978dcc971f738e802a45~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1764745732-0-0-21914c6ce5d54299214a03d1d6e8fdb4&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1764745732&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=a97ebcb387aaf4dec46f5179b8a71ec9&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2>10 平台资源订购</h2>
<p><strong>平台管理-我的资源</strong></p>
<p>Versatile智能体平台支持购买套餐包，购买后使用Versatile智能体平台的全量功能。</p>
<p>业务价值：支持用户按需选购资源，包括免费版和商用版，升级商用版可便捷使用平台全量功能，满足业务需求。</p>
